title: Danish Government Scholarship
about: The University of Copenhagen, Denmark, considers non-EU/EEA applicants offered admission to its master's programmes for the Danish Government Scholarship; there is no separate scholarship application. Programme pages list 15 January, 23:59 CET as the application deadline for fee-paying applicants starting September 2027.
requirements: Citizen of a country outside the EU, EEA or Switzerland
Time-limited residence permit for study in Denmark
card_alt: Card for the "Danish Government Scholarship" at the University of Copenhagen in Copenhagen, Denmark; deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows Nyhavn harbour in Copenhagen.
